title: E-FRC-0195: what the history of the string predicts for color singlets (stand-ins for nucleons): the paid Z3 string...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0195 in the gauge arena: what the history of the string predicts for color singlets (stand-ins for nucleons): the paid Z3 string is the 3-state Potts model (exact on a D4 patch), any number of singlets binds with exactly zero energy, partner exchange adds no entropy, and the counted singlet levels predict the meson size the dynamics shows.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
